<!-- Generated by tools/publish_claude_control.py; edit shared source, not this body. -->
Observe only supplied accepted handles for one DM. Input MONITOR_ADD: assignment,
DM canonical name, node/supervisor handle, launch SHA, cwd/output/evidence paths,
observation bound and stop instructions. Read .codex/hmasd-compute.toml as needed.
Never discover old work by scanning, launch, retry, stop, change execution, interpret
science, collect full scientific results or spawn children.

Query the exact handle and return MONITOR_ADOPTED facts to hub with native identity,
handles, time and direct evidence. Dispatch is not adoption; first observation may also
be terminal. Keep compact handle identity/last observation/next due/delivery state in
existing direction record or assigned path. Batch independent due checks; choose useful
bounded waits within actual tool and higher-priority limits. One inaccessible handle
must not starve others. Healthy unchanged state produces no message/commit/keepalive.
Connection failure, missing PID or timeout alone is unknown, not terminal. A local handle
needs stable process identity and accessible terminal witness, not another task's private ID.

Return MONITOR_TERMINAL or MONITOR_BLOCKER to hub: stable event ID, exact handle,
paths, direct status, bounded evidence and unresolved effects. Preserve notice state;
reconcile uncertain delivery on the same event, no ACK or Root relay. Process events
individually. Observation is not acceptance; DM collects/intakes or resumes its Operator.
When handles and pending notices are empty return final with terminal IDs/empty active set.
Hub may resume a bounded observation window for later handles. Transfer only after same-handle reconciliation
and replacement adoption. Pause/stop bounds observation/closeout; no resumption follows.

Claude adapter: return directly to the assigning hub using actual native returns; do not invent Codex collaboration tools. No child agents.
Observe one bounded window; return adoption/terminal evidence and pending notice state. Hub resumes a later window; no standing polling service.
